themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying demands for 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to public services, housing, and welfare. This theme appears prominently in Spain, Italy, Sweden, and Norway, with Vox, Fratelli d’Italia, Lega, Sverigedemokraterna, and Fremskrittspartiet leading the charge. The framing often ties immigration to economic strain, resonating with local election dynamics and coalition negotiations.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox pushes 'national priority' in regional governments (Andalusia, Castilla y León) and municipal councils (Seville, Zaragoza), demanding preferential treatment for Spaniards in housing, healthcare, and social services. Rejected by PP in some cases, but forms part of coalition agreements.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega and FdI advocate for 'Italiani prima' policies, particularly in housing and welfare, with local governments in Emilia-Romagna and Veneto implementing preferential access for citizens. Meloni’s government resists EU pressure to dilute these measures.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD proposes 'Swedes first' policies in municipal housing and social welfare, with local councils in Malmö and Gothenburg debating preferential treatment for citizens. Aligns with national rhetoric on immigration and integration.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP advances 'national priority' in local councils (Oslo, Bergen), particularly in housing and childcare subsidies. Data shows higher support among Thai and Polish immigrants, but opposition from Somali and Pakistani communities.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN’s Jordan Bardella reiterates 'priorité nationale' in media appearances, framing it as a solution to economic inequality and social tensions. Le Pen’s party uses it as a key differentiator in the 2027 presidential race.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentina’s President Javier Milei faces growing disapproval and internal factionalism, with polls showing a 58% rejection rate. His libertarian coalition, La Libertad Avanza, is fractured by power struggles between Karina Milei’s faction and allies of Economy Minister Luis Caputo. The theme resonates in Argentina and among right-wing parties in Spain, the U.S., and Italy, who initially praised his reforms but now distance themselves from his instability.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei’s approval drops to 30% amid economic stagnation and internal conflicts. Karina Milei and Caputo factions clash over judicial appointments and asset declarations, with allies like Manuel Adorni delaying transparency filings.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox distances itself from Milei, criticizing his economic policies as 'harmful' and 'populist.' Santiago Abascal avoids public endorsements, focusing instead on Spain’s own political crises.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump officials praise Milei’s reforms in Washington but privately express concerns about his erratic leadership. U.S. media highlights parallels between Milei’s instability and Trump’s own governance challenges.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni’s government avoids direct criticism but notes Argentina’s economic struggles as a cautionary tale. Lega’s Salvini mocks Milei’s 'insurance revolution' as unrealistic for Italy.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN’s Bardella cites Milei’s struggles as proof that 'radical libertarianism' fails in practice, contrasting it with RN’s 'pragmatic' approach to economic policy.

themes.title: Trump’s face on currency sparks global debate
themes.blurb: The Trump administration’s proposal to print a $250 bill featuring the president’s portrait has sparked transnational reactions, with coverage in the U.S., Germany, France, and Italy. The move, framed as a commemoration of the U.S. 250th anniversary, is criticized as a violation of federal law and an authoritarian gesture. European far-right parties like RN and Lega have praised it as a symbol of 'strong leadership,' while mainstream media outlets compare it to historical precedents of personality cults.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration pushes for $250 bill with his portrait, citing 250th anniversary of U.S. independence. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confirms design, pending congressional approval to bypass federal law.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD’s Alice Weidel praises the move as 'bold leadership,' contrasting it with Germany’s 'weak' euro policies. Party members share memes comparing Trump to historical figures like Bismarck.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN’s Jordan Bardella calls it 'a return to national pride,' contrasting it with France’s 'submission' to EU fiscal rules. Le Pen’s party uses it to criticize Macron’s 'anti-patriotic' economic policies.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega’s Salvini jokes about Meloni adopting a similar policy, while FdI’s Giorgia Meloni avoids direct comment but notes Italy’s own debates over commemorative coins.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties have made significant gains in recent local elections across Europe, with coverage highlighting victories in Italy (FdI/Lega), Spain (Vox), Germany (AfD), and Sweden (SD). The theme emphasizes parallel developments, such as coalition formations, policy shifts, and backlash against mainstream parties. Media framing often links these gains to broader discontent with immigration, economic policies, and EU governance.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: FdI and Lega secure key mayoral victories in Venice, Reggio Calabria, and Vicenza, with Meloni’s party consolidating control over local councils. Lega’s Salvini highlights 'law and order' as a winning issue.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox gains seats in Andalusia and Castilla y León, forming coalitions with PP in regional governments. Party leader Santiago Abascal frames it as a 'rejection of Sánchez’s corruption.'

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD wins mayoral races in Brandenburg and Saxony-Anhalt, with local councils debating cooperation with the party. CDU and SPD struggle to maintain 'firewall' policies.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD gains influence in municipal councils (Malmö, Gothenburg), pushing for stricter immigration policies and housing prioritization. Polls show SD as the second-largest party in upcoming national elections.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN wins mayoral races in southern France, with Jordan Bardella framing it as a 'rejection of Macron’s elitism.' Party prepares for 2027 presidential bid.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are grappling with internal divisions, with coverage highlighting power struggles, ideological splits, and leadership challenges. The theme appears in Poland (PiS), Hungary (Fidesz/Tisza), the UK (Reform UK), France (RN), Italy (FdI/Lega), and Argentina (LLA), often framed as a threat to electoral cohesion and governance stability.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS faces leadership crisis as Jarosław Kaczyński’s authority wanes. Factions split over Supreme Court appointments and alliances with Konfederacja ahead of 2027 elections.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz fractures as Péter Magyar’s Tisza Party challenges Orbán’s dominance. Internal debates over EU funds, judicial reforms, and media control intensify.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK splits over immigration policies and leadership, with Nigel Farage clashing with Richard Tice. Local council defections and candidate controversies undermine unity.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN’s Jordan Bardella faces backlash from Le Pen loyalists over policy shifts and 2027 presidential ambitions. Internal debates over alliances with Reconquête! and economic policies.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: FdI’s Giorgia Meloni struggles to maintain coalition unity as Lega’s Salvini opposes Ukraine’s EU accession and energy policies. Local factions in Veneto and Sicily demand autonomy.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: LLA fractures as Karina Milei and Luis Caputo factions clash over judicial appointments and economic policies. Manuel Adorni’s delayed asset declaration fuels tensions.
